definitions.full: H35. abiyyonah אֲבִיּוֺנָה noun feminine caper-berry (as stimulating desire) Eccl 12:5 (see GFM JBL 1891, 55 ff. ; so ᵑ9 ᵐ5 , Mishna אביונות , compare NHWB; see also ᵑ6 ; i.e. capparis spinosa , compare Ri HWB ; so Thes, Ew De, etc.; but Wetzst in De (German ed. 1875) proposes אֶבְיוֺנָה (as feminine of אביון ) the poor soul in sense = הָאֶבְיוֺנָה נִשְׁמָתוֺ compare Symm ᵑ6 , where double translation).
